notes.title: Son of Scoregasm Update 4 Released
notes.notes:
Son of Scoregasm has just been updated! This update fixes a few bugs and also add a whole new set of medals for expert mode. Can you win them all????

Cheers
Charlie

notes.title: Son of Scoregasm Update 3 Released
notes.notes:
Update 3 for Son of Scoregasm is now live on Steam!

This update fixes a number of issues you were having, and adds a new score verbosity feature whic hyou can turn on in the video options menu. Full details below:

Fixed Steam overlay not showing on Linux
Fixed text being clipped on ultra-wide monitor resolutions
Mouse scaling can now be set to over 100%
Achievement labels now show properly on Linux
More stability improvements
Other things i've forgotten!

Cheers
Charlie

notes.title: Son of Scoregasm Update 2 Released
notes.notes:
Hi,

I've just made update 2 live. This update makes some changes to the way levels are unlocked and makes the difficulty setting more obvious.

When you complete a level, both paths are unlocked on the map, instead of just the one to choose to take.
You can now change the difficulty level in the level select screen.

Cheers
Charlie

notes.title: Update 1 Released
notes.notes:
Hey,

I've just push an update to Son of Scoregasm which should hopefully fix a few issues that have been reported, such as:

Impostor ship disabled in tutorial
rumble now has a scalar rather than being on or off
easier to see which characters are selected in name entry screens
mouse scaling will default to a higher percentage (it'll move faster!)
traps disabled after level is completed to avoid erroneous achievement awarding.
more!

I've also added an Easy difficulty mode, which you can select in the difficulty menu on the map. In easy mode, enemies are a little slower and shoot less often, however they score half the points of normal mode.

Have Fun!

Cheers
Charlie
